sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, o.market_ticker AS tk, o.side AS c3, o.limit_price::text AS c4, o.quantity::text AS c5, o.status AS c6, coalesce(o.cancel_reason,'-') AS c7 FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy = 'Alimm1' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 25) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p.captured_at::text, p.market_ticker, 'pos', p.avg_price::text, p.quantity::text, p.realized_pnl::text, '-' FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 6)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
